meta_description: Adorn Painting and Decorating transforms homes across Birmingham. Expert interior and exterior painting with attention to detail. Free quotes available.
hero_subhead: From tired walls to stunning interiors, Adorn delivers pristine finishes on time and on budget across Birmingham.
services_subhead: Whether you need a single room refresh or a full house makeover, we handle interior walls, exterior cladding, woodwork, and specialist finishes.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Transform living spaces with precision wall and ceiling painting. We prepare thoroughly, use premium paints, and deliver flawless finishes in any colour or sheen you choose.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's outside. From rendered walls to wood cladding, we use weather-resistant coatings designed to last and stand up to Birmingham's climate.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery
services.desc: Expert painting and staining of doors, skirting, architrave, and fitted furniture. We sand, prime, and apply multiple coats for a furniture-quality finish.

services.title: Feature Walls & Faux Finishes
services.desc: Create visual impact with accent walls, textured effects, or decorative techniques. Perfect for adding personality to any room without major renovation.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Keep your business looking sharp. We work around your schedule—evenings and weekends—minimising disruption while delivering professional results.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Precise pattern matching and expert hanging on all wall types. We remove old paper cleanly, prepare surfaces properly, and ensure seams are invisible.

about_pullquote: I paint homes the way I'd want mine painted—meticulously and with genuine care.
about_para_1: Adorn Painting and Decorating was founded on a simple frustration: too many decorators cut corners or left homes looking rushed. After twelve years transforming Birmingham interiors and exteriors, we've built a reputation for precision, reliability, and finishes that last. Every job, large or small, gets the same attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we show up on time, communicate clearly about costs and timescales, and never rush a job. We take pride in leaving homes—and relationships—better than we found them. Word-of-mouth referrals make up over 60% of our work, which says everything.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Adorn

reviews.text: Had our lounge and hallway done. The prep work was thorough, no mess left behind, and the finish is absolutely immaculate. Took three days and Worth every penny. Very professional, turned up on time, and was genuinely friendly. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Needed our kitchen woodwork repainted after years of cooking splashes. Dave stripped everything back, undercoated, and applied two topcoats. It looks brand new. Couldn't fault the attention to detail or the final result.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: External render was looking tired. Got a free quote, price was fair, and the team finished bang on schedule in all weathers. Paint is holding up brilliantly and the house looks transformed. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: James K.
